cases.scope: Finite source-tree refinement with populations 2..5 and every legal retained prefix. Downward message publication/unlock/signal split, fast receive, actual child order, retired joins and retained next-round admission. Old controls are proposed unsafe destruction sites, not current source destruction. Positive is a delayed-reclamation obligation, not an implemented repair. Upward sends are assumed complete initially; excludes external interrupt resources, failed growth, thread creation failure, next-round implementation, VM destruction, weak memory and native acceptance.
